description: Reject one of your workspace's Forge candidates: it stops climbing the promotion ladder and keeps its evidence, with your reason added. candidate_id is an id from get_forge_status; a candidate already rejected, retired or promoted cannot be. Needs a Last Price credential with routing write scope; from the dashboard, an owner or admin. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

candidate_id.description: The candidate id, as get_forge_status gives it.

reason.description: Why, kept with its evidence; not blank.

name: reject_forge_candidate
